summary: Camtek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing reports Q1 2026 revenues of $121.7 million, a 2.5% year-over-year increase, with GAAP net income of $31.6 million ($0.63 per diluted share) and non-GAAP net income of $35.3 million ($0.70 per diluted share). Management provided second quarter revenue guidance of $129-131 million and expects over 25% revenue growth in the second half versus the first half of 2026. This is a routine earnings release on Form 6-K for a foreign private issuer, containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign. It is an ordinary operational and financial update.
